name: AI Tools (aitools.inc)

sources.title: Submit Tool page — Free Listing $0 (30–90 day queue, no guaranteed placement) and Fast Lane $129 one-time (24–48h, guaranteed placement or refund); both routes are Typeform forms

conditions: Free listing exists but enters a 30–90 day queue with NO guaranteed placement — the tool can simply never be listed

Fast Lane ($129 one-time) skips the queue with 24–48h placement, a verified listing page, category features, Newly Launched inclusion and newsletter eligibility — full refund if the tool doesn't meet listing standards
requirements: An AI tool — the directory covers AI categories (image, sales, copywriting, developer, marketing, business, video, art, audio)
Submission via Typeform (free form: loxr142exnq.typeform.com/to/RB6ZnEf2; fast lane: .../Y22Kfelk)
Tools must meet unstated 'listing standards' — fast-lane submissions get a refund if declined
preparation: Product name, URL, description, logo, category, pricing model
Decide free queue vs $129 fast lane based on launch timing (30–90 days is too slow for a launch-day push)
Founder contact for follow-up (team contact route exists on the page FAQ)
workflow: Choose 'Submit Now' under Free Listing or Fast Lane — both open Typeform forms
Complete the Typeform with product details
Free: wait 30–90 days with no guarantee; Fast Lane: pay $129 for 24–48h guaranteed placement (or refund if declined)
Verify the tool's listing page under aitools.inc/tools or its category page
watchFor: Free tier explicitly has 'No guaranteed placement' and a 30–90 day queue — treat it as a lottery ticket, not a launch channel
The Typeform links are external — verify the form asks only reasonable product data
Listing standards are not published — decline = refund only on the paid tier
Batch 'pricing: free' claim is half-true: free exists but is non-committal
countsAsLive: The tool has a public listing page on aitools.inc appearing under its category (Fast Lane also shows on Newly Launched/category features)
unknowns: Outbound link follow treatment on listing pages
